Unit systems

Source: R/physics-units-unitsystem.R
UnitSystem.Rd

UnitSystem(base_units, units, name, descr, dimension_system, derived_units) is SymPy's coherent set of units on top of a DimensionSystem(). Creating one registers it under its name for get_unit_system(); the predefined systems are "SI", "MKS", "MKSA", "Natural system" and "cgs_gauss". get_dimensional_expr() gives the dimension of an expression as an expression in the dimension names, and collect_factor_and_dimension() (SymPy's _collect_factor_and_dimension) returns list(scale_factor, dimension), checking that added terms and function arguments agree in dimension. get_units_non_prefixed() lists the units without a prefix that are not physical constants.

Usage

UnitSystem(
  base_units,
  units = list(),
  name = "",
  descr = "",
  dimension_system = NULL,
  derived_units = list()
)

# S3 method for class 'UnitSystem'
extend(
  x,
  base,
  units = list(),
  name = "",
  description = "",
  dimension_system = NULL,
  derived_units = list(),
  ...
)

get_dimension_system(us)

get_unit_system(unit_system)

get_default_unit_system()

derived_units(us)

get_dimensional_expr(us, expr)

collect_factor_and_dimension(us, expr)

get_units_non_prefixed(us)

Arguments

base_units

A list of base quantities.

units, base

A list of further quantities.

name

The name of the system.

descr, description

A description.

dimension_system

A DimensionSystem.

derived_units

Preferred units of dimensions, as a list of list(dimension, unit) pairs or a units_dict.

...

Unused.

unit_system, us, x

A UnitSystem or its name.

expr

An expression.

Value

A UnitSystem, an expression, a list or a units_dict.

Examples

u <- physics_units()
SI <- get_unit_system("SI")
get_dimensional_expr(SI, u$newton / u$meter)
#> force/length
collect_factor_and_dimension(SI, u$meter + u$kilometer)
#> [[1]]
#> 1001
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> Dimension(length, L)
#>
